key_takeaways: 노드 텍스트와 주변부 증거를 결합하는 새로운 그래프 워크 방식

en.title: Call Neighbours Yourself: Graph Walks with Destination-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation
en.hook: Explore a novel graph walk and self-distillation technique to maximize LLM reasoning capabilities over text-attributed graphs.
key_takeaways: New graph walk approach combining node text with neighbourhood evidence
Enhanced LLM reasoning performance on complex graph structures
